SELECT 
  '=== SHARED EXPORT SUMMARY ===' as header,
  
  (SELECT recipient_org FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%') as recipient_organization,
  (SELECT datetime(created_at, 'localtime') 
   FROM shared_export 
   WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%') as export_date,
  (SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.export_type') 
   FROM shared_export 
   WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%') as export_type,
  (SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.exporter') 
   FROM shared_export 
   WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%') as prepared_by
  
UNION ALL

SELECT 
  '=== DATA INCLUDED ===',
  'Protocol Revisions',
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(payload)) as num_revisions,
  (SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.lab_contacts') FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%')
FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%' LIMIT 1
UNION ALL

SELECT 
  '=== LAB CONTACT LIST ===',
  'Staff Contacts',
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_contacts) as staff_count,
  (SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.lab_contacts') FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%')
FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org LIKE '%Compliance%' LIMIT 1;
